headline: Fronts Stir Along the Strategic Line
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the fiercest movement has gathered around Weathered Expanse, Mooring County, and Palantine Berm. Weathered Expanse now reports seven Warden, no Colonial, and two neutral bases, with 73 ownership events in 24 hours and five in the latest two-hour window. Mooring County has shifted to twelve Warden-held bases, while its 47 daily events include ten in the latest six hours, though the immediate two-hour window is quiet. Palantine Berm is the newest sharp flashpoint: its bases stand three Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral, with seven events in the latest two hours and sixteen across the day. Marban Hollow remains divided at six Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral; five events have arrived in the latest two hours amid sharply rising losses. Stlican Shelf has turned fully Colonial at nine bases and logged 18 daily events, three recently. Nevish Line, holding six Warden and two Colonial bases, has also seen three events in two hours alongside heavy, accelerating casualties. Kuura Strand’s earlier bustle has gone quiet for now.
